WORKING NOTES
- The blue pattern and cat-eye sunglasses are the signature accents.
- Keep the dark backdrop to make the cream knit stand out.
Try this: Keep the dark backdrop to emphasize the cream knit.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, wavy copper
hair wears blue-tinted cat-eye sunglasses and a
long, dangling blue bead earring. She wears a
cream ribbed long-sleeve knit top with a blue and
black patterned bib panel, a matching patterned
high collar scarf, and patterned cuffs. Light wash
denim jeans with rhinestone details and her hands
rest in her pockets. Her expression is calm and
direct. A dark, textured backdrop with soft light.
Palette of cream, cornflower blue, black, and pale
denim. Bold and retro, in the style of a Y2K
knitwear catalog.
